Phase 1 · Team Four

Analyze your three assigned clients

Use the provided scenario facts and clearly labeled assumptions to build each IPS mandate.

Use the slides and data together

Start with your team's client slides. They state the case background, goal, and main constraint. Match each client to the row in the scenario-data workbook for the provided target return, standard deviation, and risk classification. Treat these as case inputs to evaluate, not automatic promises or approved limits.

Missing client facts may remain Not provided. Label and justify only essential modeling assumptions. Return and risk policies, allocation weights, and review rules are committee proposals, not supplied client facts.

Activity sequence

Work from the case evidence

1

Review client criteria

Read the assigned goals, constraints, target return, standard deviation, and risk aversion.

2

Consider risk and return preferences

Discuss risk capacity and willingness. Utility reflects the client’s return–risk trade-off; greater risk aversion gives risk a larger penalty.

3

Explain asset allocation

Propose broad equity, fixed-income, and cash weights totaling 100%, supported by the client criteria and submitted macro outlook.

4

Complete the abbreviated IPS

Complete one concise IPS per client, review the three statements together, and submit one combined PDF.

Before writing the IPS

Document, challenge, and hand off

  • Mark every material statement as a supplied fact, a reasoned assumption, or an information gap.
  • Explain the scenario clue behind each assumption and what later confirmation could change.
  • Set a provisional client guardrail that later security selection or allocation must honor.
  • Record the reasoning and an independent peer review in the Analyst Decision Log.

Return when ready

Convert scenario analysis into the client mandate

Use the three case analyses and your submitted macro outlook to complete the Phase 1 IPS mandates.
